abs.description: Return the absolute value of the argument.

attr.description: Get an attribute of an object. foo|attr("bar") works like foo.bar but can be used in cases where bar is not a valid identifier.

batch.description: A filter that batches items. It works like slice but returns lists instead of tuples. The second parameter specifies the number of items per batch, and the third parameter can be used to fill missing items.

capitalize.description: Capitalize a value. The first character will be uppercase, all others lowercase.

center.description: Centers the value in a field of a given width by adding spaces to both sides.

default.description: If the value is undefined, return the default_value, otherwise return the value. If boolean is True, treat falsy values as undefined.

dictsort.description: Sort a dict by key or value. Returns a list of (key, value) tuples.

escape.description: Convert the characters &, <, >, ", and ' in string s to HTML-safe sequences. Use this if you need to display text that might contain HTML characters.

filesizeformat.description: Format the value like a 'human-readable' file size (i.e. 13 KB, 4.1 MB, 102 bytes, etc.).

first.description: Return the first item of a sequence.

float.description: Convert the value into a floating point number.

forceescape.description: Enforce HTML escaping. This will escape &, <, >, ", and ' even if autoescaping is off.

format.description: Apply Python string formatting on the value. Useful for simple string formatting.

groupby.description: Group a sequence of objects by an attribute. Returns a list of (key, list) tuples.

indent.description: Return a copy of the string with each line indented by the given width. The first line is not indented if indentfirst is False.

int.description: Convert the value into an integer. If the conversion fails, return the default value.

join.description: Return a string which is the concatenation of the strings in the sequence. The separator between elements is d.

last.description: Return the last item of a sequence.

length.description: Return the number of items in a container.

list.description: Convert the value into a list.

map.description: Applies a filter or function to all items in a sequence and returns a new sequence with the results.

max.description: Return the largest item in a sequence.

min.description: Return the smallest item in a sequence.

pprint.description: Pretty-print a Python object. Useful for debugging.

random.description: Return a random item from a sequence.

reject.description: Filters a sequence of objects by rejecting items that match a test.

rejectattr.description: Filters a sequence of objects by rejecting items whose attribute matches a test.

replace.description: Return a copy of the string with all occurrences of substring old replaced by new.

reverse.description: Reverse the object or return an iterator that iterates over it in reversed order.

round.description: Round the number to a given precision. Methods: 'common' (default), 'floor', 'ceil'.

safe.description: Mark the value as safe which means that in an environment with automatic escaping, the value will not be escaped.

select.description: Filters a sequence of objects by selecting items that match a test.

selectattr.description: Filters a sequence of objects by selecting items whose attribute matches a test.

slice.description: Slice a sequence into slices of the given number of items. Returns a list of lists.

sort.description: Sort a sequence. By default, it sorts in ascending order.

string.description: Convert the object to a string representation.

striptags.description: Strip SGML/XML tags and replace adjacent whitespace by one space.

sum.description: Return the sum of a sequence of numbers. If attribute is provided, sum that attribute of each object.

title.description: Convert a string to title case (all words capitalized).

truncate.description: Return a truncated copy of the string. The length is specified with the first parameter.

unique.description: Return a list of unique items from a sequence.

urlencode.description: Escape special characters in a string so that it can be used in a URL.

urlize.description: Convert URLs in text into clickable links.

wordcount.description: Count the number of words in a string.

wordwrap.description: Return a copy of the string with lines wrapped at the specified width.

xmlattr.description: Convert a dictionary into XML attribute syntax. Keys and values are escaped.

tojson.description: Convert the value to JSON. This is useful for embedding data in HTML or JavaScript.

items.description: Return a list of (key, value) pairs from a dict. Useful for iterating over dicts in templates.
